objective: Fix the one defect e2 found in e1 (ho-mv39qe6x-01666ddf, remaining issue 4): the Sandbox adapter ignored the attempt argument of createOrder and built invoice_id as rs-<referenceId>-a1 on every attempt, so an A13 re-create would send PayPal a duplicate invoice id.
context: Rework of e1 inside its ownership only (src/payments/**, test/unit/payments/*.test.js). e2 already passes attempt: call.attempt in the create_order sender (src/services/calls.js). No Sandbox or PayPal host was contacted, RS_LIVE_MODEL and RS_LIVE_PAYPAL were never set; the Sandbox adapter ran only against test/helpers/paypal-stub.js on loopback and injected fetch doubles. Another backend-engineer works on e3 (webhooks); none of its files were touched.
expectedOutput: invoice_id = rs-<referenceId>-a<attempt> on the wire for every attempt; attempt 1 and an absent attempt unchanged; the fake adapter consistent with the Sandbox adapter on the createOrder argument.
acceptanceCriteria: createOrder in sandbox.js sends invoice_id rs-<referenceId>-a<attempt>; attempt 2 sends -a2 in the request body the stub recorded; attempt 1 and no attempt send -a1; reference_id and custom_id stay attempt-free

attempt is validated at the boundary in the shared checkArguments: absent is allowed (defaults to 1), otherwise a positive integer up to 999 (0, negatives, floats, strings, NaN, Infinity, objects, booleans, 1000 are 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT and nothing is sent or stored), for both adapters
the fake stores no invoice id (fake_paypal_orders has no such column), so nothing else changes there; it accepts attempt, creates a new order for a re-create and rejects a bad attempt the same way
task verification command and npm test run through evidence run
completedWork: (1) test/unit/payments/sandbox.test.js: two failing-first tests (the invoice_id per attempt: 1, 2, 12 and absent, asserted on the body the stub recorded, reference_id/custom_id unchanged; and the attempt validation table, asserting the stub saw no call). (2) test/unit/payments/fake.test.js: one failing-first test (attempt 1 and 2 give two distinct orders, no invoice id in the answer, bad attempts rejected 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT with nothing stored). Before the fix 3 tests failed (sandbox 2, fake 1; 76 of 79 passed in the two files). (3) src/payments/sandbox.js: createOrder destructures attempt = 1 and builds invoice_id as `rs-${referenceId}-a${attempt}` (comment: PayPal refuses a repeated invoice_id). (4) src/payments/provider.js: exported MAX_ATTEMPT = 999 and a create_order check in checkArguments that rejects an attempt that is not undefined or an integer from 1 to MAX_ATTEMPT with INVALID_ARGUMENT. invoice_id length stays within PayPal's 127 characters (rs- + 64 + -a + 3). After the fix the task verification passes (487 tests, 480 pass, 0 fail, 7 skipped). Known gap: the failing-first run of the three new tests was a plain node --test run, not recorded through evidence run, so there is no ev: id for the red state; the green state is recorded.

The task verification (payment adapter unit tests, contract suite on both adapters, listener header test) is green: ev:ev-mv39tjrx-01f5aff3.

Carried unchanged by reference: the open items of ho-mv38f42c-010fb379 and ho-mv38jhfn-01d2ca04 (e1's earlier handoffs), in particular the LIVE-DEPENDENT Sandbox facts (approval-link host, statuses after a buyer cancel, issue names, DUPLICATE_INVOICE_ID behaviour for a merchant with duplicate-invoice checking, void and capture semantics) that stay unverified until the opt-in live suite (RS_LIVE_PAYPAL=1) runs. lessonDecisions.note: The lesson concerns a hook or guard that maps file writes to a project record or root in a repository with several records; this task changes a payment adapter argument and its unit tests and designs no hook, guard or root discovery, so the 'Applies when' list does not hold.
